      All stories
      Source: 15 Punjab newspapers (Ajit, Jagbani, Punjabi Tribune, Punjabi Jagran, Rozana Spokesman, Punjab Kesari, Dainik Jagran, Dainik Bhaskar, Dainik Savera, The Tribune, Hindustan Times, Times of India, Indian Express, The Savera Times). Each day's monitoring deck was read clipping by clipping, plus a sweep of the full editions for stories it missed. Every story is coded for relevance, sentiment, theme and page placement.
